Jobomschrijving

Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region. 

We offer an initial fixed-term contract of 1 month, starting on 1 September, allowing sufficient time for onboarding and knowledge transfer followed by a replacement contract covering a maternity leave and subsequent absence.

The total expected assignment duration is approximately 12 months.

Your Role:

As an Air Export Administrative Agent, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of air export shipments while ensuring excellent customer service throughout the shipment lifecycle. You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations. 

Key Responsibilities:

Air Freight Administration
	
• Track and trace air export shipments through online systems and email communication.	
• Manage and process shipment-related documentation accurately. 	
• Upload shipment documents into electronic document management systems.	
• Support the handling of shipment pre-alerts and storage requirements, including temperature-sensitive shipments. 	
• Follow up on active container leasing and end-of-lease activities. 
Customer Service
	
• Inform customers proactively about shipment status updates and delays.	
• Respond professionally to customer inquiries.	
• Ensure customer requirements and operating procedures are consistently respected. 
Compliance & Operational Excellence
	
• Escalate operational issues to management when necessary.	
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and service quality.	
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.	
• Follow up on operational discrepancies and system-related issues.	
• Assist with claim notifications to airlines when required. 

Your Profile:

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.

Requirements
	
• Knowledge of the air freight process and transport documentation.	
• A background in Transport & Logistics or a similar education is highly valued.	
• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.	
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.	
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
Proactive and able to work independently. 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.
	
• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).	
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues.
Personal Qualities
	
• Customer-focused and service-minded.	
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.	
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.	
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.	
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

Main Responsibilities

The Technical Sales Manager contributes annually to the development of a strategic sales plan, in consultation with management (including objectives, KPIs, segmentation, and action points). In addition, weekly consultations and monthly reporting will be required.

Building and expanding a proactive and sustainable network of customers, prospects, partners (suppliers, machine builders, ...)

In most projects, the Technical Sales Manager will act as coordinator between customers, engineering offices, partners, suppliers, and the Revimaxx team.

You continuously monitor the market and trends and also share these internally. You pay attention to developments in technologies, relationships between customers/partners, subcontracting, opportunities, ...

You are open to and contribute to active marketing support, social media communication, participation in trade fairs, training sessions, ...

In this role, a combination of technical/mechanical expertise and a sense for economic reality is necessary. This may have been built through experience, interest, education... or perhaps through a combination of these.

• Industrial Engineer, Civil Engineer, or equivalent through experience
• Initial technical sales and/or consultancy experience (with technical expertise) and demonstrable results are a must, with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
• You have a strong affinity with the machine construction sector and are passionate about the mechanical possibilities of small and large machines/systems.
• Your commercial experience motivates you to independently evaluate opportunities and pursue them.
• You are conceptually strong and enjoy thinking together with the customer in a co-creative way to arrive at the best solution for their challenge.
• You are analytical and skilled with numbers in order to quickly determine margins and feasibility of projects. You have a sense for the economic reality of each project.
• You possess strong communication skills and communicate effectively with customers, partners, and the Revimaxx team. (knowledge of perfect English, and willingness to learn Dutch quickly)
• You have a natural ambition to grow and to support the growth of Revimaxx.
• You are results-oriented, loyal, flexible, and demonstrate strong perseverance.
• You hold a valid for wheel driving licence.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

• Coordinate and oversee all aspects of maritime transportation operations, including vessel scheduling, cargo handling, and port logistics. 
• Liaise with shipping carriers, freight forwarders, and customs authorities to ensure timely and cost-effective cargo movement. 
• Maintain accurate records of cargo shipments, documentation, and tracking information. 
• Maintain strong relationships with existing clients while proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities. 
• Resolve any shipping-related issues or discrepancies in a timely manner. 
• Accomany the GM on client visits as required by business needs (infrequent)
 
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is preferred. 
• Over 3 years proven experience in shipping operations or maritime logistics. 
• Familiarity with international shipping regulations and customs procedures. 
• Strong computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office and shipping software. 
• Excellent communication skills.Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages is a plus. 
• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities. 
• Ability to work effectively under pressure . 
• Team player with a proactive and positive attitude.

For an international and multicultural organisation based in Brussels, we are looking for an Administrative & Events Assistant to join their team.

In this role, you will be responsible for a variety of administrative and organisational tasks, while also supporting the organisation of events and activities.

Your profile as Administrative and Events Assistant : 

• Has a first experience in administration, or is a recent graduate looking to develop their experience
• Is organised, proactive and hands-on
• Is able to work independently and take initiative
• Has good common sense and a strong sense of responsibility
• Is discreet and understands the importance of confidentiality
• Enjoys organising events and making sure everything is taken care of

Ghent Region | Leadership experience | GMP & cleanroom | Shift system | 1110509

About the organization 
Our client is an international manufacturing company active in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector. From their site in Flanders, they produce innovative therapies that improve patients' lives worldwide. The organization is known for its high-tech environment, strong growth, and a culture where collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement are key.

Your new role
As a Production Supervisor, you are the heartbeat of a GMP manufacturing environment. You lead operational teams and ensure that all processes meet the highest standards of quality and safety.

Your responsibilities include:

• Leadership and coaching: Motivate and guide production teams in a cleanroom environment.
• Compliance and audits: Ensure adherence to cGMP standards and act as a key contact during inspections.
• Documentation management: Oversee procedures, batch records, and ensure timely release.
• Process improvement: Initiate projects to enhance efficiency, quality, and safety.
• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with QA, QC, Engineering, and Supply Chain.
• Training: Ensure your team is well-trained and foster a culture of ownership and learning.
You will report directly to the Operations Manager.

 

What we expect from you

• Bachelor or Master degree in science, bioengineering, pharmacy, or equivalent through experience
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a GMP environment, preferably in biotech or pharma
• Knowledge of cGMP regulations and cleanroom operations
• Strong communication and organizational skills
• Proficiency in MS Office; experience with MES/EBR systems is a plus
• Fluent in English (Dutch is an asset)

Ghent region | bachelor in Lab or Biotechnology | GMP, cleanroom, LIMS | Quality Control | 1110364
About the organization
Our client in the Ghent region is an international company with a production site where highly regulated processes are carried out. The environment is modern, structured and safety‑focused. You will join a team where quality, collaboration and precision are key.

 

Your new role
As a Lab Technician, you will perform quality control on advanced therapies in a GMP environment. You will take samples, carry out analyses (including flow cytometry and glucose testing), and monitor the cleanroom environment (ISO 5). You will work closely with Quality and Operations, manage test results in LIMS, and contribute to optimizing processes and documentation.

 
 

What do we expect from you?

• Bachelor's degree in lab technology, biotechnology or equivalent
• Knowledge of GMP and quality standards (FDA/EU)
• Experience with aseptic techniques or cleanrooms is a plus
• Strong communication skills in Dutch and technical English
• Accurate, well-organized and a true team player

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Junior Accountant (M/V/X) - Antwerp.

Our client is an innovative organization with a long-term vision and a strong commitment to sustainable value creation. You will join a collaborative finance environment where strategy, finance and entrepreneurship come together in support of lasting growth.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as a Junior Accountant (M/V/X) include:

• You support the day-to-day accounting activities across multiple group entities and help ensure financial records are accurate, complete and up to date.
• You process invoices, bank transactions and journal entries, and contribute to the monthly, quarterly and annual closing processes.
• You assist in monitoring balance sheet accounts and help maintain a high level of financial accuracy and compliance.
• You contribute to the preparation of periodic financial reports for internal and external stakeholders.
• You support the preparation of statutory financial statements, audit documentation, reconciliations and balance sheet analyses.
• You help optimize and standardize accounting and financial processes within an evolving finance organization.
• You support the implementation of internal controls and accounting policies to strengthen the control environment and improve efficiency.
• You assist with finance-related projects, analyses and administrative tasks, and provide support to colleagues with financial questions.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in accountancy, Finance or a related field, combined with around three years of relevant professional experience.
• You have strong technical skills and an excellent command of Microsoft Excel.
• You have experience with SAP or another ERP system, which is considered a strong asset.
• You have a basic knowledge of IFRS, which is an advantage.
• You have an interest in or experience with real estate and/or private equity structures.
• You are analytical, accurate, proactive and eager to learn.
• You work well in a team and communicate smoothly with colleagues.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

This requires a deep understanding of our solutions and the ability to solve technical puzzles. You will take full ownership of client questions ensuring that users receive the right advice, can use the product effectively and have their issues resolved quickly and efficiently. As you master our platform and understand the different configurations of our clients, this role offers a clear growth path towards an implementation consultant or customer success account management role.
 

How you'll make an impact

• Adapt and adjust existing custom configurations tailored to the needs of our clients. 

• Create and maintain 
customer-facing support documentation and tutorial videos. 

• Thoroughly reproduce, verify and analyze reported bugs, resolving what you can and 
accurately translating issues for the product team. 

• Own the end-to-end communication for client issues, ensuring the user stays informed and guided even when an issue is escalated. 

• Build a deep 
understanding of each client’s specific setup to provide proactive support. 

• Collaborate closely with internal teams (product team, Information Security team) to ensure timely and high-quality support. 

What we're looking for
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business Engineering, or a similar field, or equivalent experience in a similar role. 

• A customer-centric professional with 
excellent communication skills who genuinely enjoys helping experts solve complex problems. 

• Fluency in 
English ( 
spoken and written) is an absolute must. 

• Ability to translate business needs or functional problems into 
clear technical requirements. 

• A 
strong analytical mindset. You don’t just pass along an issue, you investigate the root cause and resolve the issue yourself or introduce short-term workarounds to unblock the client. 

• A strong affinity for 
complex enterprise SaaS software solutions combined with the eagerness to learn about MRM and AI governance. 

• Python skills are a plus. 

• Hands-on experience in database and SQL is a plus.

ownership mentality, taking full responsibility issues from the moment they are raised until the final solution is communicated.

ambitious individual looking to grow into an implementation consultant expert or account manager role focused on deep product expertise.

Adecco is looking for an enthusiastic Customer Support Officer to strengthen the Volvo Action Service team at Volvo Group! 

Help drivers get back on the road quickly and efficiently. As a Breakdown Assistance Call Handler, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and ensure that every driver receives help as quickly as possible. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed at all times.

This is a role with real impact: thanks to your calm approach, strong communication skills, and solution-oriented mindset, you truly make a difference during stressful situations. Your responsibilities: 

 
• Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing a breakdown on the road. 
 

 
• Analyze the problem by assessing the situation and gathering the necessary information. 
 

 
• Organize interventions and dispatch them to breakdown services, partners, or internal technicians. 
 

 
• Follow up on cases from A to Z, ensuring clear and continuous communication with the driver. 
 

 
• Register all relevant information in the system (time, location, nature of the problem, planning, etc.). 
 

 
• Remain calm in emergency situations and always act with a strong customer focus. 
 

 
• Work closely with a dedicated team that is available 24/7 to provide optimal customer support. 

What do we expect from you? 

 
• You have strong communication skills and are able to handle phone calls clearly, empathetically, and professionally. 
 

 
• You are stress-resistant and able to maintain an overview in busy and demanding situations. 
 
•  
Problem-solving comes naturally to you. 

 
•  
You are fluent in English and German (minimum B2 level) and another European Language. 

 
• You are comfortable working with digital tools and handling administrative follow-up. 
 
•  
You are willing to work flexible shifts: early, late, day and weekends — truck drivers are on the road anytime, anywhere. 

 
•  
Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside/mobility assistance is a plus, but not a requirement. 

 
• You hold a bachelor's degree or have relevant equivalent experience. 
 

 
• You have your own means of transportation.

Service Technician
